description: Collect public Pinterest comments, replies and Tried It activity from numeric Pin URLs or IDs. No login or proxy setup is required.

commentSort.description: Source keeps Pinterest's ranking; newest and oldest sort the fetched comments by their published date.
commentSort.title: Comment order

domain.description: Regional Pinterest site used for every request. Use the region shown in the Pin link.
domain.title: Pinterest region

includePinSummary.description: Emit one pinCommentsSummary row with the Pin, creator, board, media, commerce and engagement context.
includePinSummary.title: Include Pin summary

includeReplies.description: Fetch public replies for comments that have them.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

maxActivity.description: Tried It and other public activity rows to collect per Pin.
maxActivity.title: Maximum activity rows per Pin

maxComments.description: Top-level comments to collect per Pin; replies are counted separately. Legacy limit input is still accepted in code.
maxComments.title: Maximum top-level comments per Pin

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Reply rows to collect for each top-level comment. Set to 0 to skip replies.
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Maximum replies per comment

minHelpfulCount.description: Drop comment, reply and activity rows whose published helpful count is lower. Rows without a published count are kept.
minHelpfulCount.title: Minimum helpful votes

minLikeCount.description: Drop comment, reply and activity rows whose published like count is lower. Rows without a published count are kept.
minLikeCount.title: Minimum likes

mode.description: Choose comments with replies, Tried It activity, both, or only the Pin summary.
mode.title: What to collect

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. The actor works directly and falls back to the automatic Apify proxy without user setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Optional proxy

sinceDate.description: Optional inclusive date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) for comments, replies and activity. Leave empty for no lower bound.
sinceDate.title: Published on or after

untilDate.description: Optional inclusive date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) for comments, replies and activity. Leave empty for no upper bound.
untilDate.title: Published on or before

urls.description: One or more numeric Pinterest Pin links or IDs, e.g. https://www.pinterest.com/pin/142567144448888376/. Legacy pinUrls and startUrls inputs are still accepted in code.
urls.title: Pinterest Pin URLs or IDs

title: Pinterest Pin Comments Input
